findings.text: No rule says what happens to a "Builds on" field that holds no backtick reference, such as `- Builds on: the report`. lint.structure.field-known accepts it, lint.references.reference has nothing to resolve, and the Rationale of lint.references says its other text says nothing, so the element silently depends on nothing. Yet baseline.dependencies rests on the claim that only this field says what an element builds on.
